title: Apply a Firewall Baseline (firewalld or ufw)
description: Idempotently opens a list of ports/services on firewalld (RHEL/Rocky) or ufw (Debian) and leaves everything else alone -- a quick way to apply the same baseline ruleset across mixed-OS nodes.

variables.name: ALLOWED_SERVICES
variables.prompt: firewalld service names to allow, space-separated (only used for firewalld); e.g. 'ssh nfs'

variables.name: ALLOWED_PORTS
variables.prompt: Extra ports to allow, space-separated, each as PORT/PROTO (e.g. '6817/tcp 6818/tcp')
